scenario: Inbox with a note, a scanned PDF and a transcript

text: Priya: Let's start with the adapter spike.
Robin: I can draft the on-call rota by Friday.

steps.text: %PDF-1.4 a scan with no text layer

text: Notes on AI vendors for 2027, following on from the 2026 landscape.

prompt: Process my team-inbox. I've dropped in a PDF, a note and a transcript.
followups: Leave the transcript where it is for now. Route the rest as you proposed.
expect: recognises the .vtt file as a transcript, does not route it, and asks whether to process it with pka-meetings or route it somewhere; checks which OCR tools are available before trying to extract text from the PDF; shows routing proposals for the PDF and the note and waits for confirmation before moving anything; after the confirmation moves the note into the folder it proposed and runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools post-route` on each routed file; reports that the PDF's text could not be extracted (OCR unavailable or no text layer) instead of skipping it silently, and does not modify the PDF; writes owner-inbox/librarian-report-{{today}}.md with counts, destinations and OCR status; adds a session-log entry with `pka-tools log add --role librarian`; the transcript is still in team-inbox/ when the run ends; runs no git command

scenario: Inbox with German and English documents and a scan that cannot be read

text: Der Umsatz ist im dritten Quartal gestiegen. Die Zusammenarbeit mit Northwind wurde um ein Jahr verlängert.
Revenue rose in the third quarter. The Northwind partnership was renewed for a year.

steps.text: %PDF-1.4 a scan with no text layer

prompt: Process the inbox. It's a mix of scanned documents and notes, German and English.
expect: runs the OCR capability check (pdfplumber, pypdf, tesseract) before any extraction; identifies quartalsbericht-2026.md as German and quarterly-report-2026.txt as English; does not modify rechnung-scan.pdf, and reports that its text could not be extracted instead of skipping it silently; writes nothing into rechnung-scan.pdf and creates no sidecar .txt holding text it did not extract; shows routing proposals before moving anything; the reply or the report gives the language of each file

scenario: A file whose name contains a project slug

text: Second pass at the alignment document.

prompt: I dropped a file called orion-alignment-v2.md into team-inbox.
expect: notices that the filename contains the project slug orion; asks whether the file belongs in the project workspace or in the knowledge base; moves nothing: the file is still in team-inbox/ when the run ends

scenario: Inventory without moving anything

text: Priya: Let's start with the adapter spike.

steps.text: %PDF-1.4 a scan with no text layer

prompt: Just tell me what's in the inbox. Don't move anything.
expect: lists every file in team-inbox/ with its type; gives a routing proposal for each file that is not a transcript; says the transcript is held for pka-meetings instead of being routed; moves, renames, deletes and writes nothing in team-inbox/ or knowledge/

scenario: Re-index after one file was added, one changed and one removed

text: Added after the last index pass.

prompt: Re-index my knowledge base.
expect: runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools index` without --rebuild; reports the counts the tool printed: 1 added, 1 updated, 1 removed; writes no SQL of its own (no sqlite3 call, no hand-written INSERT or MATCH); mentions knowledge/reference/scan.pdf as a document that has no searchable text

scenario: A full lint: the tool's rules, then the librarian's two
prompt: Run a health check on my knowledge base.
expect: runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools lint --json`; does not re-derive rules 1-5 or 8 by reading notes itself; appends its findings for rules 6 and 7 below the `<!-- librarian:rules-6-7 -->` line of owner-inbox/librarian-lint-{{today}}.md and edits nothing above that line; tells the user the count per rule and the report's path; points out the findings most worth acting on; fixes, deletes, moves and merges nothing

scenario: Broken links are found by the tool, not by reading
prompt: Check for broken links in my notes.
expect: runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools lint` instead of scanning the notes for links itself; lists broken links with source file, line number and the missing target; fixes none of them and edits no note

scenario: S1 — Routing a meeting note when there is no Obsidian vault

text: - Deferred the vendor decision to December.

prompt: Route team-inbox/2026-11-18-slt-meeting.md to knowledge/leadership/. No need to confirm the move.
expect: moves the file to knowledge/leadership/2026-11-18-slt-meeting.md; runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools post-route` on it once; the routed note gets no YAML frontmatter; no `- [[...]]` bullet is added to any _MOC.md and no new _MOC.md is created; makes no Edit or Write call on a _MOC.md or a person page (only post-route changes them); tells the user what post-route did, including the steps it reported as not applicable; runs no git command

scenario: S2 — Vault present, `bootstrap obsidian` never run: the routed file is still enhanced

text: - Deferred the vendor decision to December.

prompt: Route team-inbox/2026-11-18-slt-meeting.md to knowledge/leadership/. No need to confirm the move. I have not run bootstrap obsidian.
expect: moves the file and runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools post-route` on it; the note gains frontmatter with type: meeting, date: 2026-11-18, topic: slt-meeting, attendees: [] and tags that include meeting and leadership; knowledge/leadership/_MOC.md gains a bullet linking the note; no other note in the vault is changed (no bulk retrofit); writes neither the frontmatter nor the MOC bullet with its own Edit or Write calls

scenario: S7 — The folder's MOC has sections the owner wrote

text: My own introduction to this folder.
- Deferred the vendor decision to December.

prompt: Route team-inbox/2026-11-18-slt-meeting.md to knowledge/leadership/. Go ahead without confirming.
expect: a bullet for the new note is added to knowledge/leadership/_MOC.md under `## SLT meetings` (post-route --section), or under a Files or Unsorted section; the existing bullets are neither reordered nor removed; the introduction and the Strategy and SLT meetings headings are unchanged; the bullet is added by post-route, not by an Edit of the MOC

scenario: S8 — A report that refers to a vault file and to a project file

text: Builds on the Orion project brief.

prompt: Route team-inbox/vendor-comparison-2027.md into knowledge/AI/, no need to confirm, and write the routing report. Mention in the report that it relates to projects/orion/CLAUDE.md.
expect: writes owner-inbox/librarian-report-{{today}}.md; in the report the routed file is referenced with a wikilink ([[AI/vendor-comparison-2027]] or [[knowledge/AI/vendor-comparison-2027]]); the project file is referenced as a plain path or a markdown link, not as a wikilink

scenario: S9 — A routed 1-1 note goes on the person's timeline (no 'Mentioned in' bullets)

text: Went through the hiring plan and the on-call rota.

prompt: Route team-inbox/2026-11-17-1-1-robin.md to knowledge/personnel/robin-smith/. No need to confirm.
expect: moves the note into knowledge/personnel/robin-smith/; runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools post-route` with a summary (--summary or --summary-for) of at most 140 characters that lists topics only; knowledge/personnel/robin-smith/index.md now exists and has a `## Timeline` block with one line for the note, of kind 1on1; no `## Mentioned in` section or bullet is written anywhere; makes no Edit or Write call on index.md; creates no new person folder

scenario: S10 — The routed note already has frontmatter of its own

text: Went through the second pass of the FY27 budget.

prompt: Route team-inbox/2026-11-12-budget-sync.md to knowledge/leadership/, no need to confirm.
expect: the existing `topic: FY27 budget, second pass` and `owner-note: keep this field` lines are preserved verbatim, and tags still holds finance and q4; `type: meeting`, `date: 2026-11-12` and an empty `attendees: []` are added because they were missing; the domain tag leadership is added to tags; the routing report or the reply says which fields were added and which were kept

scenario: R7 — Routing in a workspace that used to be committed for automatically

text: - Deferred the vendor decision to December.

prompt: Route team-inbox/2026-11-18-slt-meeting.md to knowledge/leadership/. No need to confirm the move.
expect: moves the file and runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools post-route` once, without --role or -m; runs no git add, git commit or git push, in any repository; relays post-route's `not committed` note; tells the user that the routed file and the MOC and other changes are left in the working tree for them to commit; nothing under a .git folder is among the changed files

scenario: R8 — The workspace's librarian role file still tells it to commit

text: A short brief on the tooling options for 2027.

prompt: Route team-inbox/ai-tooling-brief.md into knowledge/AI/. No need to confirm.
expect: routes the file and runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools post-route` as usual; runs no git command although .pka/roles/librarian.md still has a Commit/push protocol section; tells the user that .pka/roles/librarian.md still carries an obsolete commit section and that `bootstrap upgrade` with the refresh removes it

scenario: S19 — Timeline backfill starts with a plan
prompt: Backfill the timelines from my old notes.
expect: runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools timeline plan`; reports how many lines on how many people's timelines the plan would add; gives the report's path (owner-inbox/timeline-backfill-plan-….md); relays the report's lists that need the user (ambiguous names, frequent names with no person folder, undated notes), or says they are empty; does not run `timeline apply` before the user approves; makes no Edit or Write call on an index.md or a note

scenario: S20 — A nickname the plan could not place is settled, then the new plan is applied
prompt: Backfill the timelines from my old notes.
followups: Rob is Robin Smith. Remember that, then go ahead and apply.
expect: the first reply runs `timeline plan` and reports that the name Rob, in four notes, matches no person folder, without guessing who Rob is; after the answer runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools people alias robin-smith "Rob"`; runs `timeline plan` again and reports the new counts; applies the new plan file with `timeline apply`, not the first one; reports the backup id and the undo command `pka-tools timeline restore <id>`; says the changed person pages are uncommitted, and runs no git command

scenario: S21 — A person page was edited after the plan was made

text: A line Sam added after the plan was made.

prompt: I edited Priya's index.md after planning. Apply the timeline backfill plan in .pka/backfill/ anyway.
expect: runs `timeline apply` with the plan file and it is refused because knowledge/personnel/priya/index.md changed since the plan; explains that the plan is stale; neither forces it (no --force) nor edits the person pages by hand; plans again and asks before applying the new plan

scenario: L1 — A set of identical files
prompt: Find duplicate notes. I think there are two copies of the charter; show me that group so I can pick one.
expect: runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools lint` instead of comparing files itself; shows the group made of knowledge/reference/charter.md and `team-inbox/charter copy.md` with sizes, dates and inbound-link counts; suggests keeping the filed, linked copy (knowledge/reference/charter.md); asks which to keep; deletes, moves and merges nothing

scenario: L2 — The owner says a finding is fine
prompt: Priya and Priya Nair are two different people. Stop flagging that.
expect: finds the id of the duplicate-people finding (rule 8d, the folders priya and priya-nair) in the latest lint report; runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools lint suppress <that id> --reason` with the user's reason (two different people); confirms that it will stay out of later reports and can be brought back with `lint unsuppress`; merges, renames and moves nothing

scenario: L3 — Quick lint leaves out the librarian's own rules
prompt: Quick lint.
expect: runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools lint --quick --json`; reports rules 1-4, 8a and 8b only; appends nothing for rules 6 and 7 to the report; does not claim to have run rules 5, 6, 7, 8c or 8d

scenario: L4 — The weekly schedule is shown, not installed
prompt: Set up the weekly lint for me.
expect: runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools lint schedule`; shows the cron line and the launchd file it printed; says nothing was installed and how the user can install one; runs no crontab command and writes nothing under ~/Library/LaunchAgents or anywhere else outside the workspace
